The '''Mortis monolith''' was a structure in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]].

==History==
The monolith acted as a gateway into the realm of [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], where the [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]], [[Son/Legends|Son]] and [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]]&mdash;three [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] known as [[The Ones/Legends|The Ones]]&mdash;resided as anchorites, cut off from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They represented the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] as well as the balance in between. If one died, all the others would die too; it was impossible for them to live without each other. When the monolith opened up in the middle, a blinding white light came from within. Each side of the monolith was over 5,000 meters long.<ref name="O" />

In the year [[44 ABY]], after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Abeloth]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sent [[Quest Knights|ten]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] out to search for the monolith. The Jedi searched for the [[Dagger of Mortis/Legends|Dagger of Mortis]] to prepare for the eventual return of the former Mother.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
